facts.business: Supershakti Metaliks Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and trading of metal products, with related party transactions involving purchase and sales of metal goods.
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions include purchases from Super Smelters Limited (Rs 35.72 lakhs) and Giridhan Metal Private Limited (Rs 34,170.95 lakhs), sales to Super Smelters Limited (Rs 37.77 lakhs) and Giridhan Metal Private Limited (Rs 1,011.49 lakhs), and transactions with Sai Electricals Private Limited (Rs 894.95 lakhs). All transactions are at arm's length basis.
